description: Plan 08 - Crews plugin integration: track which crew member's session worked on each phase of each Ralph task. Adds CrewSessionRef[] per RalphStage to RalphPipelineState, populated from a heuristic cross-walk of .crews/crews/*/members/* and .crews/crews/*/leads/* manifests plus explicit subcommand writes from /work-on --via-crew. Wires .crews/ events into the watcher, adds crewsRoot config plumbing with linked-worktree resolution against the main repo root, and renders crew session rows in the chip tooltip extras slot.

planReviewContext.description: parseWatchedPath() in scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs (lines ~273-304) has a hardcoded rootEntries array with three items (job, group, brainstorm). The plan says it will recognize a new 'crews' kind, but doesn't specify the code structure. Additionally, the flush handler currently maps every pending change to deriveAffectedTaskUpdate({ repoRoot, config, kind, slug, ... }). For kind='crews' with no slug, deriveAffectedTaskUpdate's behavior is undefined.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: In Story 6, specify: (a) parseWatchedPath() detects .crews/crews/ and .crews/sessions-configs/ paths BEFORE the Ralph rootEntries loop and returns {kind: 'crews'} with no slug; (b) the flush handler branches on kind==='crews' and invokes a new dedicated helper rescanCrewSessionsAndWrite(currentState, config, repoRoot, overviewData) instead of deriveAffectedTaskUpdate. This helper re-runs discoverCrewSessions, merges results into currentState.byTaskId[*].crewSessions (preserving _isExplicit entries), and calls writeSidecar() with no Ralph re-derivation.

planReviewContext.description: .ralph/overview-config.schema.json has additionalProperties: false at the top level. Adding crewsRoot to default-config.mjs without also adding it to the schema will cause schema-validated configs to be rejected.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Story 2 must explicitly call out adding {"crewsRoot": {"type": "string"}} to the schema properties block, alongside dataFile/ralphRoot/lockFile/watcher. Acceptance criterion: schema validation of a config that sets crewsRoot succeeds.
